newsitem.title: UK: UK grain traders bid for 66,000 tonnes wheat.
newsitem.headline: UK grain traders bid for 66,000 tonnes wheat.

text.p: UK grain traders bid for licences to export a total of 66,000 tonnes of free market wheat at the weekly European Union (EU) tender held on Thursday, the UK Intervention Board for Agricultural Produce said.
Bids ranged from 10.47 to 21.00 Ecu's, the board added.
There was no interest for free market barley, the board added.
All bids will be considered at Thursday's weekly EU cereals management committee meeting.
